title: Arduino Uno enclosure
about: a base with insert standoffs and socket notches and a lid with header windows for an Arduino Uno, every feature from a board table
tries: Add the ICSP header to uno.json and a window for it in the lid | Make the base deep enough for a shield stacked on the Uno

agent.role: an enclosure designer who drives every board feature from a table
agent.prompt: Prefer adding rows to uno.json over hand-placed features; give every socket a 1 mm gap all round; never move a standoff off the board's real hole positions.

fragments.board: Arduino Uno Rev3: 68.58 × 53.34 mm, holes at (550, 100), (600, 2000), (2600, 300), (2600, 1400) mils, USB-B centred 1.5 in up the socket edge, power jack 0.3 in up.
fragments.loops: Make one feature per table row with forEach or reduce, and name it after the row.
